description: Hidrografía urbana - Embalse/tajamar is a dataset listed in Uruguayan spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (IDEuy), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Uruguay (IDEuy). Adquisición de Hidrografía en la escala 1:1.000 obtenidas mediante Levantamiento Aerofotogrametrico en el que se utilizó la cámara UltraCam Eagle Prime con tamaño del píxel en terreno (GSD) de 10 cm y altura de vuelo aproximada de 2100 metros metros totalizando un área de mapeo aerofotogramétrico aproximadamente de 1227 km². Coverage: Uruguay. Its tags are Embalse, Tajamar, Hidrografía, inlandWaters. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-ideuy-portal.
